POPULAR LLM MODELS Architecture: Uses only the encoder part of the transformer architecture.• T5: Utilizes both the encoder and decoder parts of the transformer.• GPT: Uses only the decoder part of the transformer.• Training Data: Trained on English Wikipedia and BookCorpus.• T5: Trained on a diverse dataset called Common Crawl, which includes multiple languages and tasks.• GPT: Trained on a large dataset from the internet, including Common Crawl, books, and other texts.• Primary Use Cases: Excels at natural language understanding tasks like classification and semantic search.• T5: Designed to handle multiple natural language processing tasks out of the box, such as translation, grammar correction, an d summarization. Focuses on natural language generation tasks, including creative writing, summarization, and conversational agents.• Model Type: Auto -encoding model, which means it can use context from both sides of a blank in a sentence. Sequence -to-sequence model, capable of both encoding and generating text. Auto -regressive model, which generates text by predicting the next word in a sequence based on the previous words. • Three Main ways to use llm Encoding text into vectors: This involves using LLMs to convert text into numerical representations with little to no fine -tuning. • Fine -tuning for specific tasks: This method uses custom data to fine -tune an LLM for a particular task, leveraging transfer learning. Simply asking the LLM to solve a task by providing specific instructions without any fine -tuning or vectorization. • Section 2 Semantic Search With LLM Intro To Semantic Search Semantic Search: This type of search looks at the meaning and context of what you're searching for, rather than just matching exact words.

retrieved.educational: The encoder -decoder attention layer helps align words in the input with the output sequence.• Self-Attention in transformers layer Self-attention in transformers is a mechanism that allows words in a sentence to interact with each other to determine which words to focus on. • It uses three value to get word embeddings queue, value and key.• Here are the key points: Self -attention enables words within an input sequence to interact and understand the context by attending to other relevant words.○ Encoding Process : Each word is encoded into three vectors: query, key, and value. These vectors help the model determine the importance of each word in relation to others.○ Attention Scores : The similarity between the query and key vectors is calculated to produce attention scores, which indicate how ○ New Section 1 Page 3 Attention Scores : The similarity between the query and key vectors is calculated to produce attention scores, which indicate how much focus each word should receive.○ Weighted Values : The attention scores are used to weigh the value vectors, which are then combined to create an updated representation of each word.○ Section 4 Societal Implications of LLM Common applications of large language models": Content Creation and Text Summarization: LLMs can generate various types of content, such as articles, blogs, and product descriptions, enhancing content automation .• Language Translation: LLMs help overcome language barriers by providing accurate translations, though they may struggle with less common languages .• Question Answering Systems: LLMs are used in chatbots, virtual assistants, and customer support systems to provide quick and relevant responses.• Code Generation: LLMs can generate and debug code in multiple programming languages, aiding both professional developers and learners.• Sentiment Analysis: LLMs analyse emotions and opinions in texts, useful for customer feedback, social media monitoring, and market research.• Audio and Video Transcription: LLMs transcribe audio and video files into text, saving time and effort. • Fraud Detection and Cybersecurity: LLMs analyse text data to detect fraud and recognize patterns indicating malicious activity. • Education and Healthcare: LLMs personalize learning materials and contribute to medical diagnosis and treatment by analyzing vast amounts of data.• GenAI -Working with LLM Section 2 training transformers and their architecture Transfer Learning -
